questions.prompt: What is the officer pay grade O-1?
questions.explanation: O-1 is Second Lieutenant (2d Lt), the rank most AFROTC cadets commission into. Ensign is the Navy's O-1.

questions.prompt: What insignia does a Second Lieutenant wear?
questions.explanation: A Second Lieutenant wears one gold bar. A First Lieutenant wears one silver bar.

questions.prompt: What insignia does a First Lieutenant (O-2) wear?
questions.explanation: A First Lieutenant wears one silver bar. In US officer insignia, silver outranks gold.

questions.prompt: What insignia does a Captain (O-3) wear?
questions.explanation: A Captain wears two connected silver bars, sometimes called "railroad tracks."

questions.prompt: A gold oak leaf is the insignia of which rank?
questions.explanation: Major (O-4) wears a gold oak leaf. Lieutenant Colonel (O-5) wears a silver oak leaf.

questions.prompt: A silver oak leaf is the insignia of which rank?
questions.explanation: Lieutenant Colonel (O-5) wears a silver oak leaf. Again, silver outranks gold.

questions.prompt: What insignia does a Colonel (O-6) wear?
questions.explanation: A Colonel wears a silver eagle, which is why colonels are sometimes called "full bird" colonels.

questions.prompt: How many stars does a Major General wear?
questions.explanation: Brigadier General (O-7) wears one star, Major General (O-8) two, Lieutenant General (O-9) three, and General (O-10) four.

questions.prompt: What is the pay grade of a Lieutenant General?
questions.explanation: Lieutenant General is O-9 and wears three stars. Note that a Lieutenant General outranks a Major General.

questions.prompt: How do you correctly address a Lieutenant Colonel in conversation?
questions.explanation: Lieutenant Colonels are addressed as "Colonel." Likewise, First and Second Lieutenants are both "Lieutenant," and all generals are "General."

questions.prompt: How do you address a Brigadier General in conversation?
questions.explanation: All general officers, from one star to four, are addressed as "General."

questions.prompt: What is the Air Force rank at pay grade E-1?
questions.explanation: E-1 is Airman Basic, which has no insignia. E-2 is Airman, and E-3 is Airman First Class.

questions.prompt: What is the Air Force rank at pay grade E-4?
questions.explanation: E-4 is Senior Airman (SrA). The Air Force no longer uses the rank of Sergeant at E-4.

questions.prompt: Which is the first Air Force enlisted rank in the noncommissioned officer (NCO) tier?
questions.explanation: Staff Sergeant (E-5) is the first NCO rank. Master Sergeant (E-7) is the first senior NCO (SNCO) rank.

questions.prompt: What is the pay grade of a Technical Sergeant?
questions.explanation: Technical Sergeant (TSgt) is E-6. Staff Sergeant is E-5 and Master Sergeant is E-7.

questions.prompt: Which enlisted ranks are senior noncommissioned officers (SNCOs)?
questions.explanation: The senior NCO tier is Master Sergeant (E-7), Senior Master Sergeant (E-8), and Chief Master Sergeant (E-9).

questions.prompt: What is the correct Air Force abbreviation for Second Lieutenant?
questions.explanation: The Air Force writes "2d Lt" and "1st Lt." "2LT" is the Army's style.

questions.prompt: What is the abbreviation for Senior Master Sergeant?
questions.explanation: Senior Master Sergeant is SMSgt. Similar patterns: MSgt, CMSgt, TSgt, SSgt.

questions.prompt: Who is the only person ever to hold the five-star rank of General of the Air Force?
questions.explanation: Henry "Hap" Arnold was made General of the Army in 1944 and General of the Air Force in 1949, the only person to hold that rank.

questions.prompt: Who is the senior enlisted advisor to the Chief of Staff of the Air Force?
choices: Chief Master Sergeant of the Air Force
Senior Enlisted Leader of the Joint Staff
questions.explanation: The Chief Master Sergeant of the Air Force (CMSAF) is the Air Force's top enlisted leader and advises the Chief of Staff and Secretary of the Air Force.
